claims.statement: Replay executed before pickup slots were corrected; orders re-booked into closed (expired) slots and remain held. This confirms m8_r_owner precondition: 'Replaying held allocations is safe only after their pickup slots have been corrected.'

Root cause fully established: Carrier partition 2 (east-node) feed consumer stopped at 05:58, 47 minutes behind; slots booked against stale carrier data. EXC-0921 orders have expired pickup windows (30 min slots vs 47 min confirmation lag). Consumer must be restarted to allow live data flow and enable slot correction.

Mitigation sequence: (1) Restart partition 2 feed consumer (DevOps/Carrier Ops); (2) Apply slot correction to partition 2 (reversible per m8_r_owner); (3) Replay allocations (safe after slots corrected per m8_r_owner precondition). Evidence: one re-booked order after carrier data refresh confirmed successfully (m8_r_handoffs).
claims.limitation: Consumer restart is outside incident assessor authority per m8_e07; requires escalation to platform team.

next_action.rationale: Root cause firmly established with discriminating evidence: partition 2 feed consumer stuck at 05:58, creating 47-minute lag that exceeds 30-minute slot windows. V18 split reservations trigger routing to partition 2; this is the causal linkage. Impact: 186 orders stuck with expired slots. Mitigation: Restart partition 2 consumer, then apply slot correction, then replay allocations (all reversible per m8_r_owner). Consumer restart is outside assessed authority; escalate to DevOps/Carrier Operations platform team. Mission objective satisfied: root cause explained and mitigation path documented.
